+    
+    def _get_flatpak_license(self, app_id: str) -> List[str]:
+        """Get license information for a Flatpak application."""
+        try:
+            # Try to get metadata which might contain license info
+            result = subprocess.run(
+                ["flatpak", "info", "--show-metadata", app_id],
+                capture_output=True,
+                text=True,
+                check=True
+            )
+            
+            # Look for license information in metadata
+            licenses = []
+            for line in result.stdout.split('\n'):
+                if 'license' in line.lower():
+                    # Extract license value
+                    if '=' in line:
+                        license_value = line.split('=', 1)[1].strip()
+                        if license_value:
+                            licenses.append(license_value)
+            
+            # If no license found in metadata, try to infer from app ID
+            if not licenses:
+                licenses = self._infer_flatpak_license(app_id)
+            
+            return licenses if licenses else ["unknown"]
+            
+        except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, FileNotFoundError):
+            return self._infer_flatpak_license(app_id)
+    
+    def _infer_flatpak_license(self, app_id: str) -> List[str]:
+        """Infer license based on Flatpak app ID patterns."""
+        # Common patterns for FOSS apps
+        foss_patterns = {
+            'org.mozilla.': ['MPL-2.0'],
+            'org.gnome.': ['GPL-3.0-or-later'],
+            'org.kde.': ['GPL-2.0-or-later'],
+            'org.libreoffice.': ['MPL-2.0'],
+            'org.videolan.': ['GPL-2.0-or-later'],
+            'org.gimp.': ['GPL-3.0-or-later'],
+            'org.blender.': ['GPL-3.0-or-later'],
+            'org.audacityteam.': ['GPL-2.0-or-later'],
+            'org.inkscape.': ['GPL-3.0-or-later'],
+            'org.freedesktop.': ['MIT'],
+        }
+        
+        # Check for known FOSS patterns
+        for pattern, licenses in foss_patterns.items():
+            if app_id.startswith(pattern):
+                return licenses
+        
+        # Default to unknown for unrecognized patterns
+        return ["unknown"]
